puzzle.hint: A divine attribute describing Allah's abundant forgiveness.
puzzle.arabicVerse: وَإِنِّى لَغَفَّارٌۭ لِّمَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًۭا ثُمَّ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
puzzle.verse: 20:82 - But indeed, I am the Perpetual Forgiver of whoever repents and believes and does righteousness and then continues in guidance.
